item.title: Russia and Ukraine trade attacks, killing 10, including child in Chernihiv
item.description: Kyiv says Russian strikes killed six, including a child at a supermarket, as Moscow says Ukrainian strikes killed four.

item.title: Firefighters battle to contain wildfires still burning near Bordeaux
item.description: Wildfires in southwestern France are continuing to burn near the city of Bordeaux.

item.title: Why Mali’s northern conflict has entered a dangerous new phase
item.description: A separatist–al-Qaeda alliance has shifted the balance of power in northern Mali and complicated efforts to end the war.

item.title: Massive iceberg capsizes off the coast of Greenland
item.description: A massive iceberg capsized off the coast of Ilulissat, Greenland flipping with force to reveal its jagged underside.

item.title: Ebola infections in DR Congo surge to 3,200, with 1,405 deaths
item.description: Cases have surged by 1,000 in just 10 days as outbreak continues to spread across five provinces.

item.title: Lebanese return to homes of rubble left by Israel in so-called pilot zones
item.description: Lebanon's army has accused Israel of bulldozing homes and hindering its efforts to escort residents to 'pilot zones'.

item.title: Guterres tours Syria’s notorious ‘Assad Prison’ in Sednaya
item.description: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres toured the notorious former ‘Assad prison’ in Sednaya.

item.title: Iran war live: Tehran halts retaliatory strikes after pause in US attacks

item.title: Khamenei ties US-Iran peace deal to Israel ending attacks on Lebanon
item.description: Iran's supreme leader calls for 'absolute, unconditional termination' of Israel's attacks on Lebanon.

item.title: Trump’s border czar probes possible vetting failures after ICE shooting
item.description: ICE officer under review for alleged mental health struggles, violent behavior amid deadly shooting case in Maine.

item.title: What’s causing the unprecedented wildfires in Europe?

item.title: Israeli government nods to international stabilisation force in Gaza
item.description: The ISF, to be staffed by 'friendly countries', will operate in areas outside of Israel's military control.

item.title: US and Iran hit pause on strikes for second day
item.description: The relative calm comes amid reports of renewed efforts to restore diplomatic talks.

item.title: Former President Hernandez returns to Honduras after Trump pardon
item.description: Trump called Hernandez's drug-trafficking trial a set-up by the Biden administration.

item.title: Houthis claim Saudi drone downed over northwestern Yemen

item.description: Mediation efforts continue but uncertainty remains as risks of further disruptions in international waterways grow.
